.NET MAUI 11.0.0 GA

.NET MAUI 11.0.0 GA

.NET MAUI 11.0.0 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 410 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

✨ New in .NET 11

The following 247 features and changes are unique to .NET 11 and not yet in the main branch:

Ai Agents

  • Remove only legacy /review rerun queue and scanner by @kubaflo in #39029

  • Preserve packed-ref access in isolated Vally workspace by @PureWeen in #39025

  • Add /review performance GitHub Agentic Workflow for PR benchmarks by @morning4coffe-dev in #38324

  • Use GPT-6.1 Sol for gh-aw workflows by @kubaflo in #39036

  • Add maintainer-triggered issue regression tracing by @kubaflo in #38710

  • Issue regression tracing: Bound evidence and preflight version gaps by @kubaflo in #39121

  • Add /issue triage agentic workflow for manual issue labels by @kubaflo in #39065

  • Keep /issue triage reports artifact-only while applying real labels by @kubaflo in #39201

  • Expose citation-safe prose to /issue triage by @kubaflo in #39276

  • Add /review gate without replacing full review by @kubaflo in #39189

  • Fix unattended CI-fixer evidence retrieval by @PureWeen in #39237

Animation

  • Fix AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #37639

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive

Blazor

  • Fix BlazorWebView root component subscriptions on disconnect by @sheiksyedm in #39247

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] BlazorWebViewHandler never unsubscribes from RootComponents.CollectionChanged on disconnect, retaining the old MauiContext and finished Activity

  • [Windows] Enable external file drops in BlazorWebView by @danroth27 in #37904

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] BlazorWebView should enable WebView2.AllowDrop for external file drops

  • [BlazorWebView] Fix dispatcher exception propagation by @jfversluis in #37974

  • [Android] Configure image drag support for BlazorWebView by @danroth27 in #37975

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Configure DropDataContentProvider for BlazorWebView image dragging

  • Fix problem with null VirtualView in BlazorWebViewHandler on iOS by @JimmyPun610 in #38141

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS BlazorWebView crash the app sometime

  • Fix for handler leaks by traversing non-IView Shell nodes in DisconnectHandlers() by @BagavathiPerumal in #38022

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS: DisconnectHandlers() never reaches pages inside a Shell — BlazorWebView/WebViewManager leak permanently when Window.Page is replaced

  • [Android]Fix for Android BlazorWebView crash when opening image links in a new window by @BagavathiPerumal in #38195

    🔧 Fixes
    • <a target="_blank"> with image child <img src="data:image"/> causes app crash on Android in MAUI Blazor Hybrid

BlazorWebView

  • Revert "Fix BlazorWebView root component subscriptions on disconnect" by @kubaflo in #39251

  • [.NET 11] Fix Blazor template framework selection with --Empty by @sheiksyedm in #39419

    🔧 Fixes
    • [.NET 11] CLI - Creating new MAUI Blazor Sample App from CLI is .NET 10 by default

  • Fix inflight/current BlazorWebView and UI-test build failures by @kubaflo in #38574

Button

  • Fix Windows Button flicker during transparent background transitions by @SuthiYuvaraj in #39253

CollectionView

  • Revert "[Mac] Fix VoiceOver announcement for actionable CollectionView items" by @kubaflo in #39010

  • Stabilize CollectionView header and Shell flyout UI tests by @kubaflo in #39056

  • [net 11] [Windows] Fix excessive spacing in untemplated CollectionView vertical grids by @Shalini-Ashokan in #38367

    🔧 Fixes
    • [.NET11] I1 - Big blank spaces between texts

  • [Windows] CarouselView: Fix mouse-wheel snapping by @jfversluis in #37387

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] CarouselView infinite auto-scrolling issue

  • Fix grouped CollectionView EmptyView on iOS by @jfversluis in #37959

    🔧 Fixes
    • CollectionView (grouped): EmptyView handling is wrong when groups become empty

4.0.367.0

4.0.367.0 (2026-11-10 19:10 UTC)

  • ARCRegionswitch (4.0.106.0)
    • Adds RetryableConflictException to UpdatePlan so AWS SDKs automatically retry updates that conflict with a concurrent change.
  • BedrockAgentCoreControl (4.0.127.0)
    • Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway now supports domainOverride so JWT-authorized gateways can advertise your public domain in OAuth discovery behind a proxy or custom domain. AgentCore Runtime adds warmup lifecycle hooks and specifying runtime memory via hooksConfiguration and resourceConfigurations.
  • CloudWatchOmni (4.0.103.0)
    • Release of GetSpaceDataAccess API - Used to get temporary credentials, limited to the requested actions, for working with data in a space.
  • Connect (4.0.132.0)
    • Amazon Connect now returns Contact Lens conversational analytics configuration in the DescribeContact API. Customers can retrieve a contact's analytics, redaction, summarization, and sentiment settings, consistent with the configuration already available in contact trace records and contact events.
  • DeviceFarm (4.0.103.0)
    • Adds the NONE insights type to disable insights generation for a run, a testPackageArn field in run details, and a new artifact type for device connect command logs.
  • EC2 (4.0.132.3)
    • EC2 is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • GameLift (4.0.105.0)
    • Amazon GameLift Servers adds game session placement insights. Logs show how the queue's priority configuration, along with player latency and cost data, are applied to each placement request. Use game session placement insights to diagnose why game session placements succeed, fail, or time out.
  • LakeFormation (4.0.102.0)
    • Adds support for governing AWS Glue user-defined functions with Lake Formation permissions. This release adds the UserDefinedFunction and AnyResource resources, the EXECUTE permission, and the GetTemporaryGlueFunctionCredentials and GetGlueFunctionSessionContext APIs.
  • MarketplaceAgreement (4.0.104.0)
    • This release adds the freeTrialSummary.trialEndTime field to DescribeAgreement and the freeTrialEndTime field to SearchAgreements results, so you can see when an agreement's free trial ends.
  • NetworkFirewall (4.0.107.0)
    • Firewall Policy V2 for Network Firewall
  • PCS (4.0.104.0)
    • Added support for configuring AMIs, Amazon EC2 security groups, SSH key pairs, and launch template modes when creating or updating AWS PCS compute node groups.
  • Route53Profiles (4.0.101.0)
    • Adds support for having multiple profiles on one VPC. This is done using a priority system to handle conflicts on the dataplane.
  • S3Tables (4.0.102.0)
    • Adds support for server access logging for Amazon S3 table buckets with the new PutTableBucketLogging and GetTableBucketLogging APIs.
  • SimpleNotificationService (4.0.100.26)
    • Fixed FindTopic throwing ArgumentNullException when ListTopics returns no topics (#4586)
  • VerifiedPermissions (4.0.101.0)
    • Inconsequential changes to model formatting
  • Core 4.0.103.0
    • Fixed epoch-seconds timestamps in responses picking up sub-millisecond floating-point error (for example 1762594202.123 unmarshalled as .1229999). Epoch-seconds values are now truncated to millisecond precision, per the Smithy timestamp format.
    • Reduce per-request overhead of disabled request metrics and the no-op tracer provider by avoiding allocations and locks when they are not collected.
    • The updated Standard retry behavior is now the default: transient errors are retried with shorter backoff, and throttling errors consume less retry quota. HTTP 429 responses without a recognized error code are now retried as throttling errors. DynamoDB and DynamoDB Streams clients now default to 3 retries (previously 10) unless AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS, max_attempts or MaxErrorRetry is set. The AWS_NEW_RETRIES_2026 environment variable is no longer used.
    • All service and extension packages updated to require new Core

1.11.0-beta.1 (2026-11-09)

Features Added

  • Added Attach SDK statistics per customer connection string observed in newly exported telemetry for multi-endpoint routing. A configured connection string alone no longer produces Attach in this mode, and offline-storage replays do not create or refresh Attach associations. Single-endpoint Attach is unchanged.
  • Multi-endpoint routing reads a new microsoft.ingestion_auth attribute. Telemetry marked "aad" is sent and stored separately from instrumentation-key telemetry for the same endpoint, in preparation for Microsoft Entra ID support.
  • Multi-endpoint routing can now be used with AzureMonitorExporterOptions.Credential. Only telemetry marked "aad" is sent with a token, scoped to the audience in the Azure.Monitor.OpenTelemetry.Exporter.MultiEndpointAadAudience AppContext value (public cloud by default). Without a credential, telemetry marked "aad" is dropped.
  • Added the experimental Azure.Monitor.OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Experimental.gen_ai_input_output_limit_increase AppContext switch. When enabled, the custom property truncation limit for gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages increases from 256 KiB to 4 MiB (characters) to support GenAI multimodal content. Limits are unchanged by default: 256 KiB for GenAI attributes and 8 KiB for all other custom properties.

  • Fixed a multi-endpoint offline-storage race where disk-size recounts discarded in-progress write reservations, potentially allowing storage to exceed its shared budget. (#63845)
  • Multi-endpoint Attach SDK statistics refresh version and attachment mode after late resource initialization.
  • Attach SDK statistics use monotonic time for reporting intervals and association expiry, avoiding delays caused by system clock adjustments.
  • Microsoft OpenTelemetry SDK statistics use the standard collector endpoint for all customer regions while retaining each item's EU/non-EU SDK statistics instrumentation key and customer key. Non-distro Breeze routing is unchanged.
  • Uploading telemetry from offline storage (at startup, on retry, and at shutdown) is no longer recorded as an HTTP dependency by HttpClient instrumentation.
    (#63821)
  • Fixed LogFilteringProcessor behavior in .net 11 when RandomTraceId is set. (64084)

Other Changes

  • Updated OpenTelemetry and OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting from 1.18.0 to 1.20.1, and OpenTelemetry.PersistentStorage.FileSystem from 1.1.1 to 1.1.3.
  • Removed registry-owned locks from multi-endpoint Attach SDK statistics observation and collection. Endpoint regions are cached, and observation is skipped when both stats regions are disabled.

MediaElement v12.0.0: Update to .NET 11

This release updates CommunityToolkit.Maui to .NET 11.

It also enables Runtime Async only on the net11.0-windows TFM. Runtime Async is not enabled on the Mono Runtime and is not recommended for any NuGet library that may be consumed by an app using the Mono Runtime.

We have removed code supporting the Tizen TFM as Tizen was no longer supported in .NET MAUI starting with .NET 10.

Breaking Changes

The update to .NET 11 required us to modify some APIs and their underlying behavior.

All packages
API
  • Minimum OS versions in the API. The AppBuilderExtensions classes declare [SupportedOSPlatform] iOS 15.0, Mac Catalyst 17.0 and Android 24.0 (MediaElement: Android 26.0), the .NET MAUI 11 minimums. Attributes that only restated a version below these minimums are removed or made versionless; this only relaxes the analyzer. Feature-specific changes are in the CameraView, FileSaver and FolderPicker, MediaElement, NavigationBar (Android), SemanticOrderView, and StatusBar and StatusBarBehavior sections.

The update to .NET 11 required us to modify some APIs and their underlying behavior. Please find the features you use, below, and update your apps accordingly.

All packages
API
  • Minimum OS versions in the API. The AppBuilderExtensions classes declare [SupportedOSPlatform] iOS 15.0, Mac Catalyst 17.0 and Android 24.0 (MediaElement: Android 26.0), the .NET MAUI 11 minimums.   • No Tizen API surface. The Tizen [SupportedOSPlatform] and [UnsupportedOSPlatform] attributes and the Tizen code paths are removed.
Behavior
  • Converters use the culture the binding passes. With no ConverterCulture, .NET MAUI passes CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture, as .NET MAUI 10 did.
    • These converters used the thread's CurrentCulture instead: ColorToCmykStringConverter, ColorToHslStringConverter, ColorToHslaStringConverter, CompareConverter, IsInRangeConverter, ListToStringConverter, MathExpressionConverter and MultiMathExpressionConverter.
    • Their output changes only when ConverterCulture is set or when an app's UI language differs from its regional format.
    • TextCaseConverter always used invariant casing instead, so its output also changes when the binding's culture is Turkish or Azerbaijani (see its section).
    • A null culture (calling a converter directly) keeps the previous behavior.
    • Each converter's section says what it does with the culture. ColorToRgbaStringConverter, DateTimeOffsetConverter and DoubleToIntConverter have separate changes, also in their sections.
Setup
  • .NET 11 only. The libraries target net11.0 and its platforms; .NET 10 apps should stay on the last .NET 10 releases (CommunityToolkit.Maui 15.x, CommunityToolkit.Maui.Camera 6.x, CommunityToolkit.Maui.MediaElement 10.x). The minimum OS versions are .NET MAUI 11's: iOS 15.0, Mac Catalyst 17.0 (macOS 14), Android 7.0 (API 24), Windows 10 1809 (10.0.17763); CommunityToolkit.Maui.MediaElement still requires Android 8.0 (API 26). .NET MAUI 11 itself no longer supports the older versions.
  • Tizen is no longer supported. The packages already shipped no Tizen target; .NET MAUI 11 dropped Tizen.
  • Dependencies: the libraries reference .NET MAUI 11 (Microsoft.Maui.Controls 11.0.0), and CommunityToolkit.Maui.Core references System.Speech 11.0.0 on Windows (pending: RC versions until the last commit).
Smaller changes
  • Windows: the async methods of the net11.0-windows assemblies are runtime async. No API or functional change: the compiler no longer generates async state machines for these methods (except async void ones), and the runtime handles their suspension instead.
  • Informational, from .NET MAUI 11: on iOS and Mac Catalyst, .NET MAUI 11 skips animations while the system's Reduce Motion setting is on, so the toolkit's animations (TouchBehavior, FadeAnimation, the animation behaviors) finish at once for those users. The toolkit doesn't change this.
CameraView
API
  • CommunityToolkit.Maui.Camera declares [SupportedOSPlatform] Windows 10.0.17763 (was 10.0.10240), like the other libraries.
ColorConversionExtensions
API
  • New ToCmykString(CultureInfo?) and ToHslString(CultureInfo?) overloads. A null culture uses CurrentCulture.
Behavior
  • ToHslaString(CultureInfo?) formats the hue, saturation and lightness with the given culture too, not only the alpha, so the string no longer mixes two cultures. A null culture still uses CurrentCulture.
ColorToCmykStringConverter, ColorToHslStringConverter and ColorToHslaStringConverter
Behavior
  • Percentages are formatted with the culture the binding passes (see All packages).
  • ColorToHslaStringConverter: the string no longer mixes two cultures (see ColorConversionExtensions).
ColorToRgbaStringConverter
Behavior
  • Converts back its own output in comma-decimal cultures; before, RGBA(255,0,0,0,5) under de-DE converted back to Transparent. A direct call with a null culture uses CurrentCulture both ways. (The HSLA and CMYKA converters are one-way.)
CompareConverter
Behavior
  • Strings are compared with the culture's collation, using the culture the binding passes (see All packages).
DateTimeOffsetConverter
Behavior
  • No longer applies the culture's calendar to the date: it produced wrong years under th-TH and fa-IR and threw under ar-SA. It also keeps sub-microsecond ticks.
DoubleToIntConverter
Behavior
  • Parses a string ConverterParameter with the invariant culture first, so ConverterParameter=2.5 means 2.5 for every user, and falls back to the binding's culture, so 2,5 still works in comma-decimal cultures.
  • A parameter with only . separators is now always a decimal: 1.000 under de-DE means 1 (it meant 1000).
DrawingView
Behavior
  • On iOS and Mac Catalyst, exporting an image off the main thread no longer risks a crash on .NET 11's CoreCLR (the CGColor of a temporary UIColor could be freed while it was read).
EventToCommandBehavior
API
  • New EventToCommandBehavior.EventArgsConverterCulture property (CultureInfo?, default null = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, the previous behavior).
FileSaver and FolderPicker
API
  • The [SupportedOSPlatform] attributes iOS14.0/MacCatalyst14.0 on FileSaver and FolderPicker are now iOS/MacCatalyst (see All packages).
Behavior
  • On Windows (.NET 11):
    • With no visible app window they fail with FileSaveException / FolderPickerException ("No active window found") as on .NET 10, instead of opening a dialog over a hidden window.
    • An app with no windows no longer gets an ArgumentOutOfRangeException, and .NET MAUI embedded in a WinUI app no longer gets a false "No active window found".
    • Canceling the CancellationToken closes the open save or folder dialog and returns a canceled result, as on .NET 10, instead of waiting until the person closes the dialog. If the person has the "Confirm Save As" prompt open, the save ends canceled once they answer it, and nothing is written.
    • Picks on the same window now take turns: a pick that starts while another FileSaver or FolderPicker dialog is open on that window waits until that dialog closes, and canceling its token ends the wait with a canceled result.
    • A cancel can still close a dialog that other code opened on the same window during the canceled pick, such as the app's own message box, because nothing marks a picker dialog as the toolkit's.
GravatarImageSource
Behavior
  • The default-image keyword sent to Gravatar is lowercased with the invariant culture. Under Turkish and Azerbaijani cultures identicon and monsterid were sent as ıdenticon and monsterıd, which Gravatar doesn't recognize.
IsInRangeConverter
Behavior
  • Strings are compared with the culture's collation, using the culture the binding passes (see All packages).
ListToStringConverter
Behavior
  • Numbers and dates in the list are formatted with the culture the binding passes (see All packages).
  • A custom item type whose ToString() differs from its IFormattable.ToString(null, provider) changes output even without a culture.
Maps
API
  • CommunityToolkit.Maui.Maps is removed. There is no .NET 11 version of the package; UseMauiCommunityToolkitMaps, its AppBuilderExtensions and MapHandlerWindows no longer exist. See Setup below.
Setup
  • Change the package and the startup call. Remove the CommunityToolkit.Maui.Maps package, its using CommunityToolkit.Maui.Maps; directives and the UseMauiCommunityToolkitMaps call; reference the Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Maps package directly (the toolkit package referenced it for you) and call builder.UseMauiMaps() on every platform.
  • On Windows also call builder.ConfigureEssentials(essentials => essentials.UseMapServiceToken("YOUR_AZURE_MAPS_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY")), because there the map is the WinUI 3 MapControl backed by Azure Maps and shows no map data without a valid key.
  • On Windows, .NET MAUI's Map has no IsShowingUser, no polygons, polylines or circles in MapElements, no pin labels or info windows, and no MapClicked; MoveToRegion, the Street, Satellite and Hybrid map types, traffic, scrolling, zooming and pins work.
  • See https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/maui/user-interface/controls/map?view=net-maui-10.0 and #3190.
MathExpressionConverter and MultiMathExpressionConverter
Behavior
  • The expression syntax is culture-invariant. Numbers in the expression always use . and every function name works in every culture; before, 3.5 meant 35 under de-DE and threw under fr-FR, and names containing I (PI, IF, MIN, SIN, INT, CEILING, ...) failed under tr-TR and az.
  • String inputs and str()/len() use the culture the binding passes (see All packages).
  • Quoted strings in the expression are values: they convert with the binding's culture, like the bound inputs, and are lowercased with invariant rules (under tr-TR "I" becomes "i", not "ı").
MediaElement
API
  • maccatalyst16.1, which only restated a version below the new minimums, is removed from MediaElement's iOS members, where #3222 added it after MediaElement 10.0.0 (see All packages).

Important

This release contains major breaking changes.

Read our v11 migration guide for further information.

With this release, Swashbuckle.AspNetCore adds support for generating OpenAPI 3.2 documents and for ASP.NET Core 11.

Swashbuckle.AspNetCore v11 depends on OpenAPI.NET v3.11 which introduces some breaking changes to the public API surface. More information can be found in their OpenAPI.NET v3 Upgrade Guide.

To generate OpenAPI 3.1 or 3.2 documents, change the OpenAPI version as shown in the code snippet below:

app.UseSwagger(options =>
{
    options.OpenApiVersion = OpenApiSpecVersion.OpenApi3_1;
    // ...or

Aspire 13.6.5

What's New in Aspire 13.6.5

Patch release for Aspire 13.6 with dashboard and CLI security hardening and .NET runtime servicing updates.

🐛 Fixes

  • 🖥️ Dashboard authentication is enforced on missing and unauthorized routes — Secured dashboards now check authorization before rendering the main layout for missing routes or denied access. In browser-token mode, unauthenticated users are redirected to login with the original route preserved. Additional authentication checks protect layout, dialog, interaction, and standalone terminal-window initialization; unsecured mode is unchanged. (#22071, 0b6bfe2, James Newton-King (@JamesNK))

  • 🔒 Container telemetry no longer implicitly exposes the dashboard frontend — When the Aspire container tunnel is enabled, automatic dashboard tunneling exposes only the OTLP gRPC and HTTP endpoints. Explicit references to other dashboard endpoints remain supported, and tunneling for ordinary host-resource dependencies is unchanged. (#22071, f017f66, Karol Zadora-Przylecki (@karolz-ms))

  • 🔒 CLI-generated builds and SDK working directories are isolated — Generated AppHost server and integration builds now ignore automatic MSBuild response files without changing user-authored builds or support for explicitly supplied response files. The aspire sdk generate, aspire sdk dump, and aspire sdk export commands use isolated working directories under <ASPIRE_HOME>/tmp/sdk/<unique-id>, with owner-only Unix permissions, local configuration isolation, and cleanup when the command finishes. Normal AppHost caches are unchanged. (#22071, 1ecd7cc, Sébastien Ros (@sebastienros))

  • 🔒 Agent setup no longer writes configuration content to a shared temporary log — aspire agent init stops writing agent configuration paths, configuration content, and scan diagnostics to aspire-deprecated-scan.log in the operating system's temporary directory. Deprecated MCP command detection, migration prompts, configuration updates, and existing structured debug logging are preserved. Previously written temporary log files are not removed by this update. (#22071, c408ec5, Mitch Denny (@mitchdenny))

  • 🛠️ Updated .NET runtimes and dependencies for startup reliability — Refreshes bundled runtimes and .NET servicing dependencies, including .NET 10.0.14, 9.0.22, and 8.0.33, to pick up servicing fixes relevant to Native AOT process startup. (#21348, Jose Perez Rodriguez (@joperezr))
